+@pytest.mark.parametrize('command, role_calls, collection_calls, warning', [
+    (['install'], 1, 1, False),
+    (['install', '-p', '/tmp/roles'], 1, 0, True),
+    (['role', 'install'], 1, 0, False),
+    (['collection', 'install'], 0, 1, False),
+])
+def test_install_mixed_requirements_dispatch(monkeypatch, tmp_path, capsys, command,
+                                             role_calls, collection_calls, warning):
+    req_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(req_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles:\n- example.role\ncollections:\n- example.collection\n')
+
+    role_install = MagicMock()
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    warnings = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, 'execute_install_role', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, 'execute_install_collection', collection_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.utils.display.Display, 'warning', warnings)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy'] + command + ['-r', req_file]).run()
+
+    assert role_install.call_count == role_calls
+    assert collection_install.call_count == collection_calls
+    if warning:
+        assert 'Collections cannot be installed to a roles path' in warnings.call_args[0][0]
+    output = capsys.readouterr().out
+    if role_calls:
+        assert 'Starting galaxy role install process' in output
+    if command[0] == 'collection':
+        assert 'contains roles which will be ignored' in output
+
+
+def test_install_empty_requirements_skips(monkeypatch, tmp_path, capsys):
+    req_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(req_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles: []\ncollections: []\n')
+    role_install = MagicMock()
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, 'execute_install_role', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, 'execute_install_collection', collection_install)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', req_file]).run()
+
+    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' in capsys.readouterr().out
+    role_install.assert_not_called()
+    collection_install.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_implicit_install_uses_default_collection_path(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    req_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(req_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('collections:\n- example.collection\n')
+    default_path = str(tmp_path / 'collections')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(C, 'COLLECTIONS_PATHS', [default_path])
+    install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.cli.galaxy, 'install_collections', install)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', req_file]).run()
+
+    assert install.call_count == 1
+    assert install.call_args[0][0] == [('example.collection', '*', None)]
+    assert install.call_args[0][1] == os.path.join(default_path, 'ansible_collections')
+
+
 def test_collection_install_with_relative_path(collection_install, monkeypatch):
